statement.text:
Conjecture: Let G be a hyperbolic group. Then every 2-dimensional rational
homology class is virtually represented by a sum of closed surface subgroups, that is,
for any α ∈ H2 (G; Q) there are finitely many
                                            Pclosed oriented surfaces Si and injective
homomorphisms ρi : π1 (Si ) → G such that i [Si ] = nα, where [Si ] denotes the image
of the fundamental class of Si in H2 (G).                                 D. Calegari
